what: Init creates .ignore file with .aide/memories/ entry to hide memory JSON files from grep (ripgrep). Default: hidden (memories.hideFromGrep = true). User can toggle: aide-memory config memories.hideFromGrep false. Prevents grep from bypassing structured aide_recall/aide_search access. .ignore is respected by ripgrep but does not affect git — memories stay committed.
why: Validation showed grep returning raw memory JSON mixed with code results, bypassing ranking, scoping, dedup, and recalled_count tracking.
